title: The drowning's sound (from the speculative soundscape's own material)
from: Speculative crossing soundscape (mix.py): its synthesized line and three of its recordings, each cut, high-passed at 250 Hz, faded and levelled exactly as mix.py does, panned as there

line.name: Ferosplavna-1
line.made: synthesized by mix.py's line() (hum.py's 330 kV voice: 100 Hz and its harmonics, the 6th stressed, corona hiss and cracks), seed 330, the first 15 s of its 30 s, -30 dBFS RMS before the master
line.under: from the lens crossing (5.17 s) low-passed at 380 Hz and -6 dB, crossfaded over 0.3 s: a drawn convention for hearing from under the water

layers.holds: great reed warbler (361639437), Eurasian coot (361639473), European bee-eater (361466739)
layers.recordist: (c) Oleksii Vasyliuk, some rights reserved (CC BY)
layers.place: Mar'ianske, on the drained bed, about 50 km downstream
layers.drop: faded out over 0.9 s once the drawn water reaches 9.4 m

layers.recordist: (c) W.D. Keeper, some rights reserved (CC BY)
layers.place: near Kryvyi Rih, not on the bed (no frog has been recorded or described on the bed: the frog is a guess)
layers.drop: faded out over 0.9 s once the drawn water reaches 9.85 m

layers.recordist: (c) Oleksii Vasyliuk, some rights reserved (CC BY)
layers.place: Mar'ianske, on the drained bed, about 50 km downstream
layers.drop: faded out over 0.9 s as the lens goes under

order: the reed birds first, then the frog, then the near nightingale (with the lens); the hum throughout (the user, 6 November 2026)
limit: the birds' bus at -12 dBFS, the whole at -1 dBFS (mix.py's limiter)
statement: A montage, not a recording: nothing was recorded at the crossing. No new recordings; nothing pitched, looped or stretched. The line is synthesized, not recorded; its muffling under water is drawn.
credit: Oleksii Vasyliuk (CC BY), W.D. Keeper (CC BY), via iNaturalist; the line synthesized
